scripts.static:backend-format: cd backend && uv run black src
scripts.static:backend-sync: cd backend && uv sync && echo uv OK
scripts.static:backend-black: cd backend && uv run black --check src && echo Black OK
scripts.static:backend-flake8: cd backend && uv run flake8 src --max-line-length=120 --exclude=.venv && echo Flake8: OK
scripts.static:backend-mypy: cd backend && uv run mypy src && echo MyPy: OK
scripts.static:backend-pylint: cd backend && uv run pylint src && echo Pylint: OK
scripts.static:backend: npm run static:backend-sync && npm run static:backend-black && npm run static:backend-flake8 && npm run static:backend-mypy && npm run static:backend-pylint
scripts.static: npm run static:backend && npm run static:frontend
